summary: ESS Tech, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to amend an existing at-the-market (ATM) equity offering program originally established in November 2025 for up to $75 million of common stock. The supplement updates the sales agent lineup: terminating BMO, Canaccord, Needham and Stifel, adding Roth Capital Partners, and replacing Canaccord with Roth as qualified independent underwriter. Through mid-July 2026, approximately $6.2 million of shares had been sold. The filing is a routine shelf takedown adjustment, not a special situation event.
